item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric and reconstruct the Urdu verse by verse from its Roman transcription.

---
title: "Aagosh-e-Muhammad Ka Youn Pala To Dikhao"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Yousufi"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
# source_id: tajpoints:de8e1c807028029b8cae
# source_url: https://tajpoints.com/2019/02/aagosh-e-muhammad-ka-youn-pala-to-dikhao.html
# raw_sha256: e39335757fb37ea122ee4088756ed32c08485cf52b15b2a2d27a700d0bdcb39c
---

1
Aagosh-e-Muhammad Ka Youn Pala To Dikhao.
Mujh Ko Hussain Sa Koi Mula To Dikhao.
Milti Nahi Tareekh Mein Aisi Koi Misal.
Jaisi Keh Hur Ne Ki Mujhe Toba To Dikhao.

2
Sajday Ta Qayamat Youn Adda Hote Rahein Gaye.
Khud Sajday Jis Ko Karte Hoon Sajda To Dikhao.
Ik Khutba Diya Our Ulat Dala Takh Ko.
Sajjad Ke Jaisa Mujhe Hamla To Dikhao.

3
Shak Hazrat Imran Mein Karte Ho Aap Loag.
Apno Ka Pehle Tum Mujhe Shajra To Dikhao.
Jaise Woh Aaye Pul Pe Farishte Yahi Bolay.
Iss Se Abboor Hone Ka Nama To Dikhao.

4
Aayi Hain Jab Se Gaud-e-Khadija Mein Fatima.
Abtar Ke Jaisa Phir Mujhe Tana To Dikhao.
Tableegiyon Se Yousufi Karta Hai Ik Sawal.
Mujh Ko Fidak Ke Choron Ka Chehra To Dikhao.

roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for verses, nums in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:

assert 'noUrdu' not in meta and '\\u200c' not in body
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 Urdu verses in the selected Markdown and verified that they align with the four stanzas preserved in `romanLyrics`. Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, kept the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “Mula” as مولا and “Takh” as تخت.
